profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Quest Defense
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the electrical and electronic manufacturing industry. Skilled in Computer Science, C++, Data Structures, Linux, and C (Programming Language). Strong engineering professional with a Bachleors of Science focused in Applied Mathematics from University of Arizona.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
BAE Systems T901, Full Authority Digital Engine Control (FADEC)
• Perform software development using C/C++ (Xilinx Cortex® A9/A53) on Freescale MQX RTOS
• Responsible for review HLR/LLR requirement changes and defects.
• Updates provided to FSBL, OsBOOT, SAW and COMMs Packages to resolve test issues reported.
• Responsible for building and delivering software changes on target NXP hardware.
• Utilize various test tools, and r/t monitors, Logic analyzer to provide stimulus for data collection
• Utilized DOORs for CM requirements management and Synergy for source code control.
• Full software lifecycle (DO-178B Level A), systems and software integration process experience.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Bell Helicopter FARA, Data Concentration Unit (DCU)
• DCU Perform software development using C/C++ (Xilinx Cortex® A9/A53) on DEOS RTOS
• Responsible for review HLR/LLR requirements changes and defects.
• Update BIT and BSP Package to enable test issues at PBIT/SBIT modes.
• Responsible for building and testing informal build on target NXP hardware.
• Utilize various test tools, and r/t monitors, Logic analyzer to provide stimulus for data collection
• Utilized GitLab/Sarena Dimensions for CM requirements management and source code control.
• Full software lifecycle (DO-178B Level A & B), systems and software integration process experience.

Bell Helicopter FLRAA, Cockpit Voice Flight Data Recorder (CVFDR)
• Responsible for HLR requirements update in CAMEO.
• Responsible for CAMEO Model and diagram changes in CAMEO.
• Meet with customer and suppliers and participate & estimate quotes.

Bell Helicopter LSAF, Flight Control System (FCS)
• Performs Software V&V verification on target platform.
• Responsible for reporting test issues on target hardware.
• Utilized Dimensions for CM V&V script and RFS test data archives.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Next Generation Avionics (Anthem) & FMS
• Create, analyze and update code in Microsoft VS17 (Xilinx Cortex®A9/A53) on DEOS RTOS.
• Create, analyze and update HLR/LLR requirements in Rational NG DOORS to comply with DO-178B/C.
• Analyze and update requirements and reports issues using the Atlassian Jira/Bitbucket Tool system
• Peer review lead for requirement changes and defects.

Core Software, EPIC IO & Systems
• IO Systems Focal responsible for delivering IO software builds to the customer.
• Perform software development using C/C++ (x86/MPC8270) on DEOS Operating System (RTOS)
• Responsible for developing and enhancing the IO, FTP, Network Interface Controller (NIC) software
• Responsible for producing the formal IO Systems builds & IO Software for SCM
• Utilize various test tools, and r/t monitors, Logic analyzer to provide stimulus for data collection
• Perform unit test to assure compliance with system and software requirements

Control and Middleware Software (APU/CPCS/FADEC & Control IO)
• Perform software development using C/C++ language (Microsoft & Borland) under Windows
• SW/HW Integration on x486 IO software hosted on real-time Operating System (DEOS RTOS)
• Responsible for developing & enhancing the APU, FADEC, CALF, MCDU Phone and Radio software
• Responsible for producing the final software builds for Software Configuration Management
• Perform informal qualification testing on real-time software in target platform in laboratory
• Utilize various test tools, and r/t monitors to provide stimulus, hardware control and data collection
• Perform verification testing to assure compliance with system and software requirements
• Utilized Sarena Dimensions for CM requirements management and source code control
• Familiarity with Honeywell Avionics Standard Communications Bus and ARINC 429/739 protocols
• Full software lifecycle (DO-178B Level A &B), systems and software integration process experience.
